api_base.description: The base URL of the LiteLLM API

api_key.description: The API key for authenticating with LiteLLM

insecure_skip_verify.description: Skip TLS certificate verification. Only use for development or when using self-signed certificates

agent_card_params.description: A2A agent card as a JSON object string (name, description, url, version, capabilities, skills, ...). The proxy merges in LiteLLM-fronting fields, so the configured value stays authoritative in state.

extra_headers.description: Names of incoming request headers to forward to the agent.

litellm_params.description: LiteLLM-specific parameters as a JSON object string (may include model, api_key, ...). Never read back from the API.

object_permission.description: Access control permissions as a JSON object string (mcp_servers, mcp_access_groups, mcp_tool_permissions, models, agents).

static_headers.description: Static headers sent with agent requests (may hold tokens). Never read back from the API.

budget_id.description: Unique ID for the budget. Generated by the server if not provided

budget_reset_at.description: Datetime when the budget is reset

max_budget.description: Requests fail if this budget in USD is exceeded

max_parallel_requests.description: Maximum concurrent requests allowed for this budget

model_max_budget.description: JSON string of per-model budget config (e.g. '{"gpt-4o": {"max_budget": 10.0}}')

rpm_limit.description: Maximum requests per minute allowed for this budget

soft_budget.description: Requests do not fail if this is exceeded, but alerts fire

tpm_limit.description: Maximum tokens per minute allowed for this budget

adopt_existing.description: Take over a credential of this name that already exists on the proxy instead of failing. Off by default: create reports the conflict and points at `terraform import`, so an apply never silently overwrites a credential it does not manage. Turning this on overwrites the existing credential's values with the ones in this configuration.

credential_values.description: Sensitive credential values (API keys, tokens, etc.)

model_id.description: Model ID associated with this credential

fallback_models.description: List of fallback model names in order of priority

model.description: The model name to configure fallbacks for

default_on.description: Whether the guardrail is enabled by default for all requests

litellm_params.description: JSON string with additional provider-specific litellm_params (may contain API keys)

mode.description: When to apply the guardrail: a single value ('pre_call', 'post_call', 'during_call', 'logging_only') or a JSON array of values (e.g. '["pre_call", "post_call"]')

created_at.description: Timestamp when the mapping was created

is_active.description: Whether the mapping is active. Inactive mappings are ignored during JWT auth

jwt_claim_name.description: Name of the JWT claim to match on, for example client_id, azp or sub. Must match virtual_key_claim_field in the proxy JWT config

jwt_claim_value.description: Value of the claim identifying the JWT client. Unique together with jwt_claim_name

key.description: The virtual key this claim value maps to, as plaintext. The proxy stores only a hash of it and never returns it, so drift on this attribute cannot be detected and Terraform tracks the configured value. litellm_key marks its generated key write-only, so this cannot reference a litellm_key resource; use token_id for that, or supply the plaintext from a variable or a secret manager

token_id.description: The SHA-256 hash of the virtual key this claim value maps to, which is what the proxy stores. litellm_key exposes it as token_id, so unlike key it can be referenced directly from a litellm_key resource. Not a secret, so it is not marked sensitive

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the mapping was last updated

updated_by.description: User who last updated the mapping

duration.description: How long the key stays valid, e.g. "30d" or "12h". Changing it resets the expiry to the time of the update plus the new duration; removing it leaves the current expiry in place

model_max_budget.description: JSON string of per-model budget config (e.g. '{"gpt-4o-mini": {"budget_limit": 50, "time_period": "30d"}}')

server_metadata.description: Every metadata entry the proxy stores for this key, including ones not declared in metadata. Read-only, so drift on undeclared entries shows up on refresh without Terraform taking ownership of them. Entries the provider already exposes as their own attributes (model_rpm_limit, model_tpm_limit, tags, guardrails, enforced_params, allowed_passthrough_routes, rpm_limit_type, tpm_limit_type, prompts) are omitted, and non-string values are JSON encoded

blocked.description: Whether the key is currently blocked

key.description: The API key to block, as the raw sk- value or its SHA-256 token hash. Destroying this resource unblocks the key

command.description: Command to run for stdio transport

created_at.description: Timestamp when the server was created

env.description: Environment variables for the command (stdio transport)

health_check_error.description: Error message from the last health check, if any

last_health_check.description: Timestamp of the last health check

mcp_access_groups.description: List of access groups for the MCP server

server_id.description: Unique identifier for the MCP server

status.description: Current status of the MCP server

transport.description: Transport type for the MCP server (http, sse, stdio)

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the server was last updated

updated_by.description: User who last updated the server

logo_url.description: Logo URL for the MCP server

tool_name_to_cost_per_query.description: Map of tool names to their cost per query

block.description: Cost information for MCP server tools

additional_litellm_params.description: Additional parameters to pass to litellm_params beyond the standard ones

display_name.description: Human-readable name returned as display_name by /v1/models, shown in client model pickers instead of model_name
